## What changed?

Explain the user-visible behavior and the specific reason for this change.

## How was it tested?

- [ ] Frontend build (`npm run build`)
- [ ] PHP syntax / CI checks where applicable

## Security and release considerations

- [ ] No secrets, customer data, database dumps, backups or real payment details included
- [ ] Billing and customer-balance changes are authoritative and transactional

- [ ] Local and hosted install modes considered
